chunks: Islam is built upon five things: upon salat (prayer), and zakat (alms-tax), and hajj (pilgrimage), and sawm (fasting), and al-wilayah (guardianship).
And the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The fast is a shield from the Fire.'

key_terms.الْوَلَايَةِ: Al-wilayah — in Shia theology, the authority, love, and obedience owed to the Imams of the Ahl al-Bayt; its inclusion among the pillars is a distinctively Shia doctrinal statement
key_terms.بُنِيَ الْإِسْلَامُ عَلَى: Islam is built upon — the foundational metaphor indicating that what follows are the structural pillars without which the edifice collapses
key_terms.جُنَّةٌ: Shield/protection — junnah (not to be confused with jannah/paradise); the word evokes the image of fasting as armor that protects against spiritual harm and divine punishment

ai.seo_question: What are the five pillars of Islam according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) enumerates the five foundational pillars of Islam, uniquely including al-wilayah (the authority and guardianship of the Imams) alongside the four widely recognized pillars. This hadith is significant in Shia theology as it highlights that al-wilayah — loyalty and obedience to the Ahl al-Bayt — is not an ancillary matter but a structural foundation of the faith. The Imam then quotes the Prophet's teaching that fasting serves as a spiritual shield protecting the believer from Hellfire.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim Bin Hashim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Al-Islam is based upon five things – upon the Salaat (Prayer), and the Zakaat, and the Hajj, and al-Soam (the Fast), and Al-Wilayah;
and Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The ‘الصَّوْمُ’ (the Fast) is a shield from the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Islam is founded on five isssues. It is founded on Salat (prayer), zakat, al-Hajj, Fasting and al-Wilayat (belief in Divine Authority of ’A’immah).
The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Fasting is a shield against the fire of hell.”
